summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB bundle unrelated to the SDK's declared purpose
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub releases at a pinned version, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a shipped file `math_init.js` (~727KB). math_init.js is a Bun-compiled bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, containing a shuffled string-array, a >1000-entry mixed hex/string constants table, and hex-mangled identifiers; the file is not referenced anywhere in the README or CHANGELOG and its name does not correspond to any feature of the declared data-hub HTTP SDK. The package is documented as a thin HTTP client on top of @or-sdk/base and does not require a second language runtime to operate. The combination — alternate-runtime download, obfuscated opaque payload, and preinstall auto-execution under that alternate runtime with no documentation of what the payload does — grants the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's host on every `npm install`, while smuggling the payload past Node-based static analysis by executing it under Bun.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
